   ^yellow;Decay-Based Generators^reset;
   ^blue;------------------------^reset;

Make sure to dispose of the waste cleanly (or profitably). Decay-based generators output power by gradually and randomly consuming isotopes over time. Uniquely, these generators come with multiple fuel slots, giving them the ability to vary their power output by filling the desired number of slots to adapt to any required workload without changing the fuel type, though each fuel slot may use different fuel if desired.

Decay-based generators will turn off immediately when an 'off' signal is supplied to their first blue input node, and will not waste fuel in doing so.


^red;Hydraulic Dynamo^reset;

An honourable inclusion, the Hydraulic Dynamo is an early-game generator that evaporates water using hot solids and liquids (or liquid nitrogen) in order to generate power. Although very large, it outperforms many other early generators despite being craftable on the first world and fuelled by trivially-obtainable substances such as lava and core fragments. The Hydraulic Dynamo can generate up to ^red;21W^reset; at maximum output, but will not function without water, consuming one for each fuel item used. The Hydraulic Dynamo has three fuel slots.

Accepted fuels (power per fuel slot, average decay time):
----------
Lava (4W, 10s), Core Fragment (5W, 40s), Liquid Iron (6W, 32s), Volatile Powder (7W, 40s), Scorched Core (7W, 180s), Liquid Nitrogen (6W, 20s)


^#CEF400;Fission Reactors^reset;

Good old-fashioned nuclear power, the greenest thing about it is the uranium it consumes. Fission Reactors are an affordable way to create significant amounts of power, reaching up to ^#CEF400;360W^reset; across their four fuel slots. Uniquely, this generator creates Tritium Rods as a by-product of its fission, with a 50% chance for one to be made each time a fuel item is consumed. It will also create Toxic Waste, two if Tritium is created and one otherwise. While active, depending on how long it's been operating and how much power it's generating, the Fission Generator will begin to flood its nearby area with Moderate Radiation, up to 16 tiles away. Walls and other containment will not block this, only distance and Moderate Radiation immunity will help.

^#B7E3E5;Small Fusion Reactors^reset;

Harness the power of the stars for your lab, albeit on a very small scale. Fusion Reactors of both kinds fuse light isotopes together, releasing nuclear energy from them to create power. Like the Fission Reactor, Fusion Reactors generate Moderate Radiation the longer and more productively they operate, which cannot be blocked. Small Fusion Reactors have four fuel slots, and can generate ^#B7E3E5;360W^reset; when filling all of them. They must be given coolant to continue operating or will quickly overheat and shut down, releasing a burst of radiation, though water is typically sufficient. Each consumed fuel will create one Toxic Waste, which can be used as coolant in a pinch.

廃棄物をきれいに(または利益を)処理してください。 劣化ベースの発電機は、時間とともに徐々にランダムに同位体消費によって電力を出力する。 ユニークなことに、これらの発電機には複数の燃料スロットが付属しており、燃料タイプを変更することなく必要な負荷に適応するために所望の数のスロットを充填することで、出力を変化させることができますが、各燃料スロットは必要に応じて異なる燃料を使用する場合があります。

停電ベースの発電機は、最初の青色入力ノードに「オフ」信号が供給されるとすぐに停止し、燃料を無駄にしません。


^red;油圧ダイナモ^reset;

特筆しておきたいのが、序盤に使える発電機の水力ダイナモだ。高温の固体や液体（または液体窒素）を使って水を蒸発させ、電力を生み出す。 非常に大きいにもかかわらず、それは最初の世界で製造可能であり、溶岩やコアフラグメントなどの自明に得られる物質によって燃料を供給されているにもかかわらず、他の多くの初期の発電機よりも優れています。 油圧ダイナモは最大出力で最大^red;21W^reset;を生成することができますが、水なしでは機能せず、使用する燃料アイテムごとに一つを消費します。 油圧ダイナモには三つの燃料スロットがあります。

   ^#FF612F;Fuel-Based Generators^reset;
   ^blue;------------------------^reset;

Bad for the environment and good for your factory, fuel-based generators are the backbone of any serious early- to mid-game lab or factory, producing significant power.

All fuel-based generators work using a Heat system. When fuel is first placed in the generator, or it is turned on, it will consume one fuel item and begin heating up. Its heat level, which reaches maximum productivity after 18-20 seconds, either partially or fully determines the power output of the generator. In some generators the chosen fuel determines only how quickly the generator consumes fuel, and in some the chosen fuel also provides power on top of that generated by its heat.

When a fuel-based generator is turned off, by supplying an 'off' signal to its first blue input node, it will finish consuming its current fuel item before ceasing operation to avoid wasting fuel.


^#BA893F;Alternator Generators^reset;

The first generator a player will gain access to. The Alternator Generator can only consume wood and coal, though these materials are abundant on most worlds. The Alternator Generator will only produce ^#BA893F;4W^reset; at full heat (reached after 18s), and so it should be quickly replaced by the ^gray;Combustion Generator^reset; or another power source.

   ^#FF612F;Fuel-Based Generators^reset;
   ^blue;------------------------^reset;

Bad for the environment and good for your factory, fuel-based generators are the backbone of any serious early- to mid-game lab or factory, producing significant power.

All fuel-based generators work using a Heat system. When fuel is first placed in the generator, or it is turned on, it will consume one fuel item and begin heating up. Its heat level, which reaches maximum productivity after 18-20 seconds, either partially or fully determines the power output of the generator. In some generators the chosen fuel determines only how quickly the generator consumes fuel, and in some the chosen fuel also provides power on top of that generated by its heat.

When a fuel-based generator is turned off, by supplying an 'off' signal to its first blue input node, it will finish consuming its current fuel item before ceasing operation to avoid wasting fuel.


^#BA893F;Alternator Generators^reset;

The first generator a player will gain access to. The Alternator Generator can only consume wood and coal, though these materials are abundant on most worlds. The Alternator Generator will only produce ^#BA893F;4W^reset; at full heat (reached after 18s), and so it should be quickly replaced by the ^gray;Combustion Generator^reset; or another power source.

Accepted fuels (burn time):
----------
Wooden Log (10s), Coal (16s), Golden Wood (20s), Redwood Bark (20s), Penumbral Bark (30s), Alien Weird Wood (40s), Energy Wood (50s), Aen Wood Log (60s)

環境に悪影響を及ぼし、あなたの工場にとって良い、燃料ベースの発電機は、深刻な早期から中期の研究室や工場のバックボーンであり、大きな力を生み出します。

すべての燃料ベースの発電機はヒートシステムを使用して動作します。 発電機に燃料を入れたり、電源を入れたりすると、燃料アイテムを一つ消費して加熱を開始します。 18-20秒後に最大生産性に達するその熱レベルは、発電機の出力を部分的または完全に決定する。 いくつかの発電機では、選択した燃料は発電機が燃料をどれだけ早く消費するかだけを決定し、一部の発電機では、選択した燃料は、その熱によって生成された上に電力も供給します。

燃料ベースの発電機をオフにすると、最初の青色入力ノードに「オフ」信号を供給することで、燃料を無駄にしないように操作を終了する前に現在の燃料アイテムを消費終了します。

   ^#FF612F;Fuel-Based Generators^reset;
   ^blue;------------------------^reset;

Bad for the environment and good for your factory, fuel-based generators are the backbone of any serious early- to mid-game lab or factory, producing significant power.

All fuel-based generators work using a Heat system. When fuel is first placed in the generator, or it is turned on, it will consume one fuel item and begin heating up. Its heat level, which reaches maximum productivity after 18-20 seconds, either partially or fully determines the power output of the generator. In some generators the chosen fuel determines only how quickly the generator consumes fuel, and in some the chosen fuel also provides power on top of that generated by its heat.

When a fuel-based generator is turned off, by supplying an 'off' signal to its first blue input node, it will finish consuming its current fuel item before ceasing operation to avoid wasting fuel.


^#BA893F;Alternator Generators^reset;

The first generator a player will gain access to. The Alternator Generator can only consume wood and coal, though these materials are abundant on most worlds. The Alternator Generator will only produce ^#BA893F;4W^reset; at full heat (reached after 18s), and so it should be quickly replaced by the ^gray;Combustion Generator^reset; or another power source.

Bad for the environment and good for your factory, fuel-based generators are the backbone of any serious early- to mid-game lab or factory, producing significant power.

All fuel-based generators work using a Heat system. When fuel is first placed in the generator, or it is turned on, it will consume one fuel item and begin heating up. Its heat level, which reaches maximum productivity after 18-20 seconds, either partially or fully determines the power output of the generator. In some generators the chosen fuel determines only how quickly the generator consumes fuel, and in some the chosen fuel also provides power on top of that generated by its heat.

When a fuel-based generator is turned off, by supplying an 'off' signal to its first blue input node, it will finish consuming its current fuel item before ceasing operation to avoid wasting fuel.

Bad for the environment and good for your factory, fuel-based generators are the backbone of any serious early- to mid-game lab or factory, producing significant power.

All fuel-based generators work using a Heat system. When fuel is first placed in the generator, or it is turned on, it will consume one fuel item and begin heating up. Its heat level, which reaches maximum productivity after 18-20 seconds, either partially or fully determines the power output of the generator. In some generators the chosen fuel determines only how quickly the generator consumes fuel, and in some the chosen fuel also provides power on top of that generated by its heat.

When a fuel-based generator is turned off, by supplying an 'off' signal to its first blue input node, it will finish consuming its current fuel item before ceasing operation to avoid wasting fuel.


^#BA893F;Alternator Generators^reset;

The first generator a player will gain access to. The Alternator Generator can only consume wood and coal, though these materials are abundant on most worlds. The Alternator Generator will only produce ^#BA893F;4W^reset; at full heat (reached after 18s), and so it should be quickly replaced by the ^gray;Combustion Generator^reset; or another power source.

   ^yellow;Decay-Based Generators^reset;
   ^blue;------------------------^reset;

Make sure to dispose of the waste cleanly (or profitably). Decay-based generators output power by gradually and randomly consuming isotopes over time. Uniquely, these generators come with multiple fuel slots, giving them the ability to vary their power output by filling the desired number of slots to adapt to any required workload without changing the fuel type, though each fuel slot may use different fuel if desired.

Decay-based generators will turn off immediately when an 'off' signal is supplied to their first blue input node, and will not waste fuel in doing so.


^red;Hydraulic Dynamo^reset;

An honourable inclusion, the Hydraulic Dynamo is an early-game generator that evaporates water using hot solids and liquids (or liquid nitrogen) in order to generate power. Although very large, it outperforms many other early generators despite being craftable on the first world and fuelled by trivially-obtainable substances such as lava and core fragments. The Hydraulic Dynamo can generate up to ^red;21W^reset; at maximum output, but will not function without water, consuming one for each fuel item used. The Hydraulic Dynamo has three fuel slots.

Accepted fuels (power per fuel slot, average decay time):
----------
Lava (4W, 10s), Core Fragment (5W, 40s), Liquid Iron (6W, 32s), Volatile Powder (7W, 40s), Scorched Core (7W, 180s), Liquid Nitrogen (6W, 20s)


^#CEF400;Fission Reactors^reset;

Good old-fashioned nuclear power, the greenest thing about it is the uranium it consumes. Fission Reactors are an affordable way to create significant amounts of power, reaching up to ^#CEF400;360W^reset; across their four fuel slots. Uniquely, this generator creates Tritium Rods as a by-product of its fission, with a 50% chance for one to be made each time a fuel item is consumed. It will also create Toxic Waste, two if Tritium is created and one otherwise. While active, depending on how long it's been operating and how much power it's generating, the Fission Generator will begin to flood its nearby area with Moderate Radiation, up to 16 tiles away. Walls and other containment will not block this, only distance and Moderate Radiation immunity will help.

^#B7E3E5;Small Fusion Reactors^reset;

Harness the power of the stars for your lab, albeit on a very small scale. Fusion Reactors of both kinds fuse light isotopes together, releasing nuclear energy from them to create power. Like the Fission Reactor, Fusion Reactors generate Moderate Radiation the longer and more productively they operate, which cannot be blocked. Small Fusion Reactors have four fuel slots, and can generate ^#B7E3E5;360W^reset; when filling all of them. They must be given coolant to continue operating or will quickly overheat and shut down, releasing a burst of radiation, though water is typically sufficient. Each consumed fuel will create one Toxic Waste, which can be used as coolant in a pinch.

   ^blue;------------------------^reset;

Bad for the environment and good for your factory, fuel-based generators are the backbone of any serious early- to mid-game lab or factory, producing significant power.

All fuel-based generators work using a Heat system. When fuel is first placed in the generator, or it is turned on, it will consume one fuel item and begin heating up. Its heat level, which reaches maximum productivity after 18-20 seconds, either partially or fully determines the power output of the generator. In some generators the chosen fuel determines only how quickly the generator consumes fuel, and in some the chosen fuel also provides power on top of that generated by its heat.

When a fuel-based generator is turned off, by supplying an 'off' signal to its first blue input node, it will finish consuming its current fuel item before ceasing operation to avoid wasting fuel.

The first generator a player will gain access to. The Alternator Generator can only consume wood and coal, though these materials are abundant on most worlds. The Alternator Generator will only produce ^#BA893F;4W^reset; at full heat (reached after 18s), and so it should be quickly replaced by the ^gray;Combustion Generator^reset; or another power source.

   ^#FF612F;Fuel-Based Generators^reset;
   ^blue;------------------------^reset;

Bad for the environment and good for your factory, fuel-based generators are the backbone of any serious early- to mid-game lab or factory, producing significant power.

All fuel-based generators work using a Heat system. When fuel is first placed in the generator, or it is turned on, it will consume one fuel item and begin heating up. Its heat level, which reaches maximum productivity after 18-20 seconds, either partially or fully determines the power output of the generator. In some generators the chosen fuel determines only how quickly the generator consumes fuel, and in some the chosen fuel also provides power on top of that generated by its heat.

When a fuel-based generator is turned off, by supplying an 'off' signal to its first blue input node, it will finish consuming its current fuel item before ceasing operation to avoid wasting fuel.


^#BA893F;Alternator Generators^reset;

The first generator a player will gain access to. The Alternator Generator can only consume wood and coal, though these materials are abundant on most worlds. The Alternator Generator will only produce ^#BA893F;4W^reset; at full heat (reached after 18s), and so it should be quickly replaced by the ^gray;Combustion Generator^reset; or another power source.

Accepted fuels (burn time):
----------
Wooden Log (10s), Coal (16s), Golden Wood (20s), Redwood Bark (20s), Penumbral Bark (30s), Alien Weird Wood (40s), Energy Wood (50s), Aen Wood Log (60s)

燃料ベースの発電機をオフにすると、最初の青色入力ノードに「オフ」信号を供給することで、燃料を無駄にしないように操作を終了する前に現在の燃料アイテムを消費終了します。

Make sure to dispose of the waste cleanly (or profitably). Decay-based generators output power by gradually and randomly consuming isotopes over time. Uniquely, these generators come with multiple fuel slots, giving them the ability to vary their power output by filling the desired number of slots to adapt to any required workload without changing the fuel type, though each fuel slot may use different fuel if desired.

Decay-based generators will turn off immediately when an 'off' signal is supplied to their first blue input node, and will not waste fuel in doing so.


^red;Hydraulic Dynamo^reset;

An honourable inclusion, the Hydraulic Dynamo is an early-game generator that evaporates water using hot solids and liquids (or liquid nitrogen) in order to generate power. Although very large, it outperforms many other early generators despite being craftable on the first world and fuelled by trivially-obtainable substances such as lava and core fragments. The Hydraulic Dynamo can generate up to ^red;21W^reset; at maximum output, but will not function without water, consuming one for each fuel item used. The Hydraulic Dynamo has three fuel slots.

Accepted fuels (power per fuel slot, average decay time):
----------
Lava (4W, 10s), Core Fragment (5W, 40s), Liquid Iron (6W, 32s), Volatile Powder (7W, 40s), Scorched Core (7W, 180s), Liquid Nitrogen (6W, 20s)


^#CEF400;Fission Reactors^reset;

Good old-fashioned nuclear power, the greenest thing about it is the uranium it consumes. Fission Reactors are an affordable way to create significant amounts of power, reaching up to ^#CEF400;360W^reset; across their four fuel slots. Uniquely, this generator creates Tritium Rods as a by-product of its fission, with a 50% chance for one to be made each time a fuel item is consumed. It will also create Toxic Waste, two if Tritium is created and one otherwise. While active, depending on how long it's been operating and how much power it's generating, the Fission Generator will begin to flood its nearby area with Moderate Radiation, up to 16 tiles away. Walls and other containment will not block this, only distance and Moderate Radiation immunity will help.

Accepted fuels (power per fuel slot, average decay time):
----------
Tritium Rod (10W, 40s), Deuterium Rod (15W, 50s), Uranium Rod (20W, 90s), Plutonium Rod (30W, 90s), Neptunium Rod (40W, 90s), Thorium Rod (50W, 90s), Enriched Uranium Rod (60W, 120s), Enriched Plutonium Rod (80W, 180s), Solarium Star (80W, 240s), Ultronium Rod (90W, 300s)


^#B7E3E5;Small Fusion Reactors^reset;

Harness the power of the stars for your lab, albeit on a very small scale. Fusion Reactors of both kinds fuse light isotopes together, releasing nuclear energy from them to create power. Like the Fission Reactor, Fusion Reactors generate Moderate Radiation the longer and more productively they operate, which cannot be blocked. Small Fusion Reactors have four fuel slots, and can generate ^#B7E3E5;360W^reset; when filling all of them. They must be given coolant to continue operating or will quickly overheat and shut down, releasing a burst of radiation, though water is typically sufficient. Each consumed fuel will create one Toxic Waste, which can be used as coolant in a pinch.

Accepted fuels (power per fuel slot, average decay time):
----------
Hydrogen (15W, 50s), Tritium Rod (25W, 60s), Helium-3 (45W, 80s), Solarium Star (55W, 150s), Deuterium Rod (60W, 120s), Ultronium Rod (90W, 700s)

Accepted coolants (heat reduction per item)
Toxic Waste (10), Salt Water (30), Water (30), Liquid Nitrogen (80), Cryonic Extract (125)


^cyan;Large Fusion Reactors^reset;

Originally pioneered by the Skath, Large Fusion Reactors are simply better-built, scaled-up versions of Small Fusion Reactors with a greater power output. Filling their four slots, they can generate up to ^cyan;600W^reset;. They generate radiation and produce Toxic Waste as Small Fusion Reactors do.

Accepted coolants (heat reduction per item)
Salt Water (20), Water (30), Toxic Waste (40), Liquid Nitrogen (80), Cryonic Extract (125)

Make sure to dispose of the waste cleanly (or profitably). Decay-based generators output power by gradually and randomly consuming isotopes over time. Uniquely, these generators come with multiple fuel slots, giving them the ability to vary their power output by filling the desired number of slots to adapt to any required workload without changing the fuel type, though each fuel slot may use different fuel if desired.

Decay-based generators will turn off immediately when an 'off' signal is supplied to their first blue input node, and will not waste fuel in doing so.


^red;Hydraulic Dynamo^reset;

An honourable inclusion, the Hydraulic Dynamo is an early-game generator that evaporates water using hot solids and liquids (or liquid nitrogen) in order to generate power. Although very large, it outperforms many other early generators despite being craftable on the first world and fuelled by trivially-obtainable substances such as lava and core fragments. The Hydraulic Dynamo can generate up to ^red;21W^reset; at maximum output, but will not function without water, consuming one for each fuel item used. The Hydraulic Dynamo has three fuel slots.

Accepted fuels (power per fuel slot, average decay time):
----------
Lava (4W, 10s), Core Fragment (5W, 40s), Liquid Iron (6W, 32s), Volatile Powder (7W, 40s), Scorched Core (7W, 180s), Liquid Nitrogen (6W, 20s)


^#CEF400;Fission Reactors^reset;

Good old-fashioned nuclear power, the greenest thing about it is the uranium it consumes. Fission Reactors are an affordable way to create significant amounts of power, reaching up to ^#CEF400;360W^reset; across their four fuel slots. Uniquely, this generator creates Tritium Rods as a by-product of its fission, with a 50% chance for one to be made each time a fuel item is consumed. It will also create Toxic Waste, two if Tritium is created and one otherwise. While active, depending on how long it's been operating and how much power it's generating, the Fission Generator will begin to flood its nearby area with Moderate Radiation, up to 16 tiles away. Walls and other containment will not block this, only distance and Moderate Radiation immunity will help.

Accepted fuels (power per fuel slot, average decay time):
----------
Tritium Rod (10W, 40s), Deuterium Rod (15W, 50s), Uranium Rod (20W, 90s), Plutonium Rod (30W, 90s), Neptunium Rod (40W, 90s), Thorium Rod (50W, 90s), Enriched Uranium Rod (60W, 120s), Enriched Plutonium Rod (80W, 180s), Solarium Star (80W, 240s), Ultronium Rod (90W, 300s)


^#B7E3E5;Small Fusion Reactors^reset;

Harness the power of the stars for your lab, albeit on a very small scale. Fusion Reactors of both kinds fuse light isotopes together, releasing nuclear energy from them to create power. Like the Fission Reactor, Fusion Reactors generate Moderate Radiation the longer and more productively they operate, which cannot be blocked. Small Fusion Reactors have four fuel slots, and can generate ^#B7E3E5;360W^reset; when filling all of them. They must be given coolant to continue operating or will quickly overheat and shut down, releasing a burst of radiation, though water is typically sufficient. Each consumed fuel will create one Toxic Waste, which can be used as coolant in a pinch.

Accepted fuels (power per fuel slot, average decay time):
----------

Accepted coolants (heat reduction per item)

Make sure to dispose of the waste cleanly (or profitably). Decay-based generators output power by gradually and randomly consuming isotopes over time. Uniquely, these generators come with multiple fuel slots, giving them the ability to vary their power output by filling the desired number of slots to adapt to any required workload without changing the fuel type, though each fuel slot may use different fuel if desired.

Decay-based generators will turn off immediately when an 'off' signal is supplied to their first blue input node, and will not waste fuel in doing so.


^red;Hydraulic Dynamo^reset;

An honourable inclusion, the Hydraulic Dynamo is an early-game generator that evaporates water using hot solids and liquids (or liquid nitrogen) in order to generate power. Although very large, it outperforms many other early generators despite being craftable on the first world and fuelled by trivially-obtainable substances such as lava and core fragments. The Hydraulic Dynamo can generate up to ^red;21W^reset; at maximum output, but will not function without water, consuming one for each fuel item used. The Hydraulic Dynamo has three fuel slots.

Accepted fuels (power per fuel slot, average decay time):
----------
Lava (4W, 10s), Core Fragment (5W, 40s), Liquid Iron (6W, 32s), Volatile Powder (7W, 40s), Scorched Core (7W, 180s), Liquid Nitrogen (6W, 20s)


^#CEF400;Fission Reactors^reset;

Good old-fashioned nuclear power, the greenest thing about it is the uranium it consumes. Fission Reactors are an affordable way to create significant amounts of power, reaching up to ^#CEF400;360W^reset; across their four fuel slots. Uniquely, this generator creates Tritium Rods as a by-product of its fission, with a 50% chance for one to be made each time a fuel item is consumed. It will also create Toxic Waste, two if Tritium is created and one otherwise. While active, depending on how long it's been operating and how much power it's generating, the Fission Generator will begin to flood its nearby area with Moderate Radiation, up to 16 tiles away. Walls and other containment will not block this, only distance and Moderate Radiation immunity will help.

Accepted fuels (power per fuel slot, average decay time):
----------
Tritium Rod (10W, 40s), Deuterium Rod (15W, 50s), Uranium Rod (20W, 90s), Plutonium Rod (30W, 90s), Neptunium Rod (40W, 90s), Thorium Rod (50W, 90s), Enriched Uranium Rod (60W, 120s), Enriched Plutonium Rod (80W, 180s), Solarium Star (80W, 240s), Ultronium Rod (90W, 300s)


^#B7E3E5;Small Fusion Reactors^reset;

Harness the power of the stars for your lab, albeit on a very small scale. Fusion Reactors of both kinds fuse light isotopes together, releasing nuclear energy from them to create power. Like the Fission Reactor, Fusion Reactors generate Moderate Radiation the longer and more productively they operate, which cannot be blocked. Small Fusion Reactors have four fuel slots, and can generate ^#B7E3E5;360W^reset; when filling all of them. They must be given coolant to continue operating or will quickly overheat and shut down, releasing a burst of radiation, though water is typically sufficient. Each consumed fuel will create one Toxic Waste, which can be used as coolant in a pinch.

----------

Make sure to dispose of the waste cleanly (or profitably). Decay-based generators output power by gradually and randomly consuming isotopes over time. Uniquely, these generators come with multiple fuel slots, giving them the ability to vary their power output by filling the desired number of slots to adapt to any required workload without changing the fuel type, though each fuel slot may use different fuel if desired.

Decay-based generators will turn off immediately when an 'off' signal is supplied to their first blue input node, and will not waste fuel in doing so.


^red;Hydraulic Dynamo^reset;

An honourable inclusion, the Hydraulic Dynamo is an early-game generator that evaporates water using hot solids and liquids (or liquid nitrogen) in order to generate power. Although very large, it outperforms many other early generators despite being craftable on the first world and fuelled by trivially-obtainable substances such as lava and core fragments. The Hydraulic Dynamo can generate up to ^red;21W^reset; at maximum output, but will not function without water, consuming one for each fuel item used. The Hydraulic Dynamo has three fuel slots.

Accepted fuels (power per fuel slot, average decay time):
----------
Lava (4W, 10s), Core Fragment (5W, 40s), Liquid Iron (6W, 32s), Volatile Powder (7W, 40s), Scorched Core (7W, 180s), Liquid Nitrogen (6W, 20s)


^#CEF400;Fission Reactors^reset;

Good old-fashioned nuclear power, the greenest thing about it is the uranium it consumes. Fission Reactors are an affordable way to create significant amounts of power, reaching up to ^#CEF400;360W^reset; across their four fuel slots. Uniquely, this generator creates Tritium Rods as a by-product of its fission, with a 50% chance for one to be made each time a fuel item is consumed. It will also create Toxic Waste, two if Tritium is created and one otherwise. While active, depending on how long it's been operating and how much power it's generating, the Fission Generator will begin to flood its nearby area with Moderate Radiation, up to 16 tiles away. Walls and other containment will not block this, only distance and Moderate Radiation immunity will help.

Accepted fuels (power per fuel slot, average decay time):
----------
Tritium Rod (10W, 40s), Deuterium Rod (15W, 50s), Uranium Rod (20W, 90s), Plutonium Rod (30W, 90s), Neptunium Rod (40W, 90s), Thorium Rod (50W, 90s), Enriched Uranium Rod (60W, 120s), Enriched Plutonium Rod (80W, 180s), Solarium Star (80W, 240s), Ultronium Rod (90W, 300s)


^#B7E3E5;Small Fusion Reactors^reset;

Harness the power of the stars for your lab, albeit on a very small scale. Fusion Reactors of both kinds fuse light isotopes together, releasing nuclear energy from them to create power. Like the Fission Reactor, Fusion Reactors generate Moderate Radiation the longer and more productively they operate, which cannot be blocked. Small Fusion Reactors have four fuel slots, and can generate ^#B7E3E5;360W^reset; when filling all of them. They must be given coolant to continue operating or will quickly overheat and shut down, releasing a burst of radiation, though water is typically sufficient. Each consumed fuel will create one Toxic Waste, which can be used as coolant in a pinch.

Accepted fuels (power per fuel slot, average decay time):
----------
Hydrogen (15W, 50s), Tritium Rod (25W, 60s), Helium-3 (45W, 80s), Solarium Star (55W, 150s), Deuterium Rod (60W, 120s), Ultronium Rod (90W, 700s)

Accepted coolants (heat reduction per item)
Toxic Waste (10), Salt Water (30), Water (30), Liquid Nitrogen (80), Cryonic Extract (125)

Make sure to dispose of the waste cleanly (or profitably). Decay-based generators output power by gradually and randomly consuming isotopes over time. Uniquely, these generators come with multiple fuel slots, giving them the ability to vary their power output by filling the desired number of slots to adapt to any required workload without changing the fuel type, though each fuel slot may use different fuel if desired.

Decay-based generators will turn off immediately when an 'off' signal is supplied to their first blue input node, and will not waste fuel in doing so.


^red;Hydraulic Dynamo^reset;

An honourable inclusion, the Hydraulic Dynamo is an early-game generator that evaporates water using hot solids and liquids (or liquid nitrogen) in order to generate power. Although very large, it outperforms many other early generators despite being craftable on the first world and fuelled by trivially-obtainable substances such as lava and core fragments. The Hydraulic Dynamo can generate up to ^red;21W^reset; at maximum output, but will not function without water, consuming one for each fuel item used. The Hydraulic Dynamo has three fuel slots.

Accepted fuels (power per fuel slot, average decay time):
----------
Lava (4W, 10s), Core Fragment (5W, 40s), Liquid Iron (6W, 32s), Volatile Powder (7W, 40s), Scorched Core (7W, 180s), Liquid Nitrogen (6W, 20s)


^#CEF400;Fission Reactors^reset;

Good old-fashioned nuclear power, the greenest thing about it is the uranium it consumes. Fission Reactors are an affordable way to create significant amounts of power, reaching up to ^#CEF400;360W^reset; across their four fuel slots. Uniquely, this generator creates Tritium Rods as a by-product of its fission, with a 50% chance for one to be made each time a fuel item is consumed. It will also create Toxic Waste, two if Tritium is created and one otherwise. While active, depending on how long it's been operating and how much power it's generating, the Fission Generator will begin to flood its nearby area with Moderate Radiation, up to 16 tiles away. Walls and other containment will not block this, only distance and Moderate Radiation immunity will help.

Accepted fuels (power per fuel slot, average decay time):

^#B7E3E5;Small Fusion Reactors^reset;

Harness the power of the stars for your lab, albeit on a very small scale. Fusion Reactors of both kinds fuse light isotopes together, releasing nuclear energy from them to create power. Like the Fission Reactor, Fusion Reactors generate Moderate Radiation the longer and more productively they operate, which cannot be blocked. Small Fusion Reactors have four fuel slots, and can generate ^#B7E3E5;360W^reset; when filling all of them. They must be given coolant to continue operating or will quickly overheat and shut down, releasing a burst of radiation, though water is typically sufficient. Each consumed fuel will create one Toxic Waste, which can be used as coolant in a pinch.

Although very large, it outperforms many other early generators despite being craftable on the first world and fuelled by trivially-obtainable substances such as lava and core fragments. The Hydraulic Dynamo can generate up to ^red;21W^reset; at maximum output, but will not function without water, consuming one for each fuel item used. The Hydraulic Dynamo has three fuel slots.

Accepted fuels (power per fuel slot, average decay time):
----------
Lava (4W, 10s), Core Fragment (5W, 40s), Liquid Iron (6W, 32s), Volatile Powder (7W, 40s), Scorched Core (7W, 180s), Liquid Nitrogen (6W, 20s)


^#CEF400;Fission Reactors^reset;

Good old-fashioned nuclear power, the greenest thing about it is the uranium it consumes. Fission Reactors are an affordable way to create significant amounts of power, reaching up to ^#CEF400;360W^reset; across their four fuel slots. Uniquely, this generator creates Tritium Rods as a by-product of its fission, with a 50% chance for one to be made each time a fuel item is consumed. It will also create Toxic Waste, two if Tritium is created and one otherwise. While active, depending on how long it's been operating and how much power it's generating, the Fission Generator will begin to flood its nearby area with Moderate Radiation, up to 16 tiles away. Walls and other containment will not block this, only distance and Moderate Radiation immunity will help.

Accepted fuels (power per fuel slot, average decay time):
----------
Tritium Rod (10W, 40s), Deuterium Rod (15W, 50s), Uranium Rod (20W, 90s), Plutonium Rod (30W, 90s), Neptunium Rod (40W, 90s), Thorium Rod (50W, 90s), Enriched Uranium Rod (60W, 120s), Enriched Plutonium Rod (80W, 180s), Solarium Star (80W, 240s), Ultronium Rod (90W, 300s)


^#B7E3E5;Small Fusion Reactors^reset;

Harness the power of the stars for your lab, albeit on a very small scale. Fusion Reactors of both kinds fuse light isotopes together, releasing nuclear energy from them to create power. Like the Fission Reactor, Fusion Reactors generate Moderate Radiation the longer and more productively they operate, which cannot be blocked. Small Fusion Reactors have four fuel slots, and can generate ^#B7E3E5;360W^reset; when filling all of them. They must be given coolant to continue operating or will quickly overheat and shut down, releasing a burst of radiation, though water is typically sufficient. Each consumed fuel will create one Toxic Waste, which can be used as coolant in a pinch.

Accepted fuels (power per fuel slot, average decay time):
----------
Hydrogen (15W, 50s), Tritium Rod (25W, 60s), Helium-3 (45W, 80s), Solarium Star (55W, 150s), Deuterium Rod (60W, 120s), Ultronium Rod (90W, 700s)

Accepted coolants (heat reduction per item)
Toxic Waste (10), Salt Water (30), Water (30), Liquid Nitrogen (80), Cryonic Extract (125)


^cyan;Large Fusion Reactors^reset;

Originally pioneered by the Skath, Large Fusion Reactors are simply better-built, scaled-up versions of Small Fusion Reactors with a greater power output. Filling their four slots, they can generate up to ^cyan;600W^reset;. They generate radiation and produce Toxic Waste as Small Fusion Reactors do.

Accepted fuels (power per fuel slot, average decay time):
----------
Hydrogen (35W, 50s), Tritium Rod (55W, 60s), Helium-3 (60W, 80s), Solarium Star (105W, 150s), Deuterium Rod (90W, 120s), Liquid Deuterium (90W, 120s), Ultronium Rod (150W, 700s)

Accepted coolants (heat reduction per item)
Salt Water (20), Water (30), Toxic Waste (40), Liquid Nitrogen (80), Cryonic Extract (125)

廃棄物をきれいに(または利益を)処理してください。 劣化ベースの発電機は、時間とともに徐々にランダムに同位体消費によって電力を出力する。 ユニークなことに、これらの発電機には複数の燃料スロットが付属しており、燃料タイプを変更することなく必要な負荷に適応するために所望の数のスロットを充填することで、出力を変化させることができますが、各燃料スロットは必要に応じて異なる燃料を使用する場合があります。

停電ベースの発電機は、最初の青色入力ノードに「オフ」信号が供給されるとすぐに停止し、燃料を無駄にしません。


^red;油圧ダイナモ^reset;

特筆しておきたいのが、序盤に使える発電機の水力ダイナモだ。高温の固体や液体（または液体窒素）を使って水を蒸発させ、電力を生み出す。 非常に大きいにもかかわらず、それは最初の世界で製造可能であり、溶岩やコアフラグメントなどの自明に得られる物質によって燃料を供給されているにもかかわらず、他の多くの初期の発電機よりも優れています。 油圧ダイナモは最大出力で最大^red;21W^reset;を生成することができますが、水なしでは機能せず、使用する燃料アイテムごとに一つを消費します。 油圧ダイナモには三つの燃料スロットがあります。

許容される燃料(燃料スロットあたりの電力、平均減衰時間)。
----------
Lava (4W, 10s), Core Fragment (5W, 40s), Liquid Iron (6W, 32s), Volatile Powder (7W, 40s), Scorched Core (7W, 180s), Liquid Nitrogen (6W, 20s)

Make sure to dispose of the waste cleanly (or profitably). Decay-based generators output power by gradually and randomly consuming isotopes over time. Uniquely, these generators come with multiple fuel slots, giving them the ability to vary their power output by filling the desired number of slots to adapt to any required workload without changing the fuel type, though each fuel slot may use different fuel if desired.

Decay-based generators will turn off immediately when an 'off' signal is supplied to their first blue input node, and will not waste fuel in doing so.


^red;Hydraulic Dynamo^reset;

An honourable inclusion, the Hydraulic Dynamo is an early-game generator that evaporates water using hot solids and liquids (or liquid nitrogen) in order to generate power. Although very large, it outperforms many other early generators despite being craftable on the first world and fuelled by trivially-obtainable substances such as lava and core fragments. The Hydraulic Dynamo can generate up to ^red;21W^reset; at maximum output, but will not function without water, consuming one for each fuel item used. The Hydraulic Dynamo has three fuel slots.

Accepted fuels (power per fuel slot, average decay time):
----------
Lava (4W, 10s), Core Fragment (5W, 40s), Liquid Iron (6W, 32s), Volatile Powder (7W, 40s), Scorched Core (7W, 180s), Liquid Nitrogen (6W, 20s)


^#CEF400;Fission Reactors^reset;

Good old-fashioned nuclear power, the greenest thing about it is the uranium it consumes. Fission Reactors are an affordable way to create significant amounts of power, reaching up to ^#CEF400;360W^reset; across their four fuel slots. Uniquely, this generator creates Tritium Rods as a by-product of its fission, with a 50% chance for one to be made each time a fuel item is consumed. It will also create Toxic Waste, two if Tritium is created and one otherwise. While active, depending on how long it's been operating and how much power it's generating, the Fission Generator will begin to flood its nearby area with Moderate Radiation, up to 16 tiles away. Walls and other containment will not block this, only distance and Moderate Radiation immunity will help.

Accepted fuels (power per fuel slot, average decay time):
----------
Tritium Rod (10W, 40s), Deuterium Rod (15W, 50s), Uranium Rod (20W, 90s), Plutonium Rod (30W, 90s), Neptunium Rod (40W, 90s), Thorium Rod (50W, 90s), Enriched Uranium Rod (60W, 120s), Enriched Plutonium Rod (80W, 180s), Solarium Star (80W, 240s), Ultronium Rod (90W, 300s)


^#B7E3E5;Small Fusion Reactors^reset;

Harness the power of the stars for your lab, albeit on a very small scale. Fusion Reactors of both kinds fuse light isotopes together, releasing nuclear energy from them to create power. Like the Fission Reactor, Fusion Reactors generate Moderate Radiation the longer and more productively they operate, which cannot be blocked. Small Fusion Reactors have four fuel slots, and can generate ^#B7E3E5;360W^reset; when filling all of them. They must be given coolant to continue operating or will quickly overheat and shut down, releasing a burst of radiation, though water is typically sufficient. Each consumed fuel will create one Toxic Waste, which can be used as coolant in a pinch.

Accepted fuels (power per fuel slot, average decay time):
----------
Hydrogen (15W, 50s), Tritium Rod (25W, 60s), Helium-3 (45W, 80s), Solarium Star (55W, 150s), Deuterium Rod (60W, 120s), Ultronium Rod (90W, 700s)

Accepted coolants (heat reduction per item)
Toxic Waste (10), Salt Water (30), Water (30), Liquid Nitrogen (80), Cryonic Extract (125)

Make sure to dispose of the waste cleanly (or profitably). Decay-based generators output power by gradually and randomly consuming isotopes over time. Uniquely, these generators come with multiple fuel slots, giving them the ability to vary their power output by filling the desired number of slots to adapt to any required workload without changing the fuel type, though each fuel slot may use different fuel if desired.

Decay-based generators will turn off immediately when an 'off' signal is supplied to their first blue input node, and will not waste fuel in doing so.


^red;Hydraulic Dynamo^reset;

An honourable inclusion, the Hydraulic Dynamo is an early-game generator that evaporates water using hot solids and liquids (or liquid nitrogen) in order to generate power. Although very large, it outperforms many other early generators despite being craftable on the first world and fuelled by trivially-obtainable substances such as lava and core fragments. The Hydraulic Dynamo can generate up to ^red;21W^reset; at maximum output, but will not function without water, consuming one for each fuel item used. The Hydraulic Dynamo has three fuel slots.

Accepted fuels (power per fuel slot, average decay time):
----------
Lava (4W, 10s), Core Fragment (5W, 40s), Liquid Iron (6W, 32s), Volatile Powder (7W, 40s), Scorched Core (7W, 180s), Liquid Nitrogen (6W, 20s)


^#CEF400;Fission Reactors^reset;

Good old-fashioned nuclear power, the greenest thing about it is the uranium it consumes. Fission Reactors are an affordable way to create significant amounts of power, reaching up to ^#CEF400;360W^reset; across their four fuel slots. Uniquely, this generator creates Tritium Rods as a by-product of its fission, with a 50% chance for one to be made each time a fuel item is consumed. It will also create Toxic Waste, two if Tritium is created and one otherwise. While active, depending on how long it's been operating and how much power it's generating, the Fission Generator will begin to flood its nearby area with Moderate Radiation, up to 16 tiles away. Walls and other containment will not block this, only distance and Moderate Radiation immunity will help.

Accepted fuels (power per fuel slot, average decay time):
----------
Tritium Rod (10W, 40s), Deuterium Rod (15W, 50s), Uranium Rod (20W, 90s), Plutonium Rod (30W, 90s), Neptunium Rod (40W, 90s), Thorium Rod (50W, 90s), Enriched Uranium Rod (60W, 120s), Enriched Plutonium Rod (80W, 180s), Solarium Star (80W, 240s), Ultronium Rod (90W, 300s)


^#B7E3E5;Small Fusion Reactors^reset;

Harness the power of the stars for your lab, albeit on a very small scale. Fusion Reactors of both kinds fuse light isotopes together, releasing nuclear energy from them to create power. Like the Fission Reactor, Fusion Reactors generate Moderate Radiation the longer and more productively they operate, which cannot be blocked. Small Fusion Reactors have four fuel slots, and can generate ^#B7E3E5;360W^reset; when filling all of them. They must be given coolant to continue operating or will quickly overheat and shut down, releasing a burst of radiation, though water is typically sufficient. Each consumed fuel will create one Toxic Waste, which can be used as coolant in a pinch.

Accepted fuels (power per fuel slot, average decay time):
----------
Hydrogen (15W, 50s), Tritium Rod (25W, 60s), Helium-3 (45W, 80s), Solarium Star (55W, 150s), Deuterium Rod (60W, 120s), Ultronium Rod (90W, 700s)

Accepted coolants (heat reduction per item)
Toxic Waste (10), Salt Water (30), Water (30), Liquid Nitrogen (80), Cryonic Extract (125)

The Hydraulic Dynamo can generate up to ^red;21W^reset; at maximum output, but will not function without water, consuming one for each fuel item used. The Hydraulic Dynamo has three fuel slots.

Accepted fuels (power per fuel slot, average decay time):
----------
Lava (4W, 10s), Core Fragment (5W, 40s), Liquid Iron (6W, 32s), Volatile Powder (7W, 40s), Scorched Core (7W, 180s), Liquid Nitrogen (6W, 20s)


^#CEF400;Fission Reactors^reset;

Good old-fashioned nuclear power, the greenest thing about it is the uranium it consumes. Fission Reactors are an affordable way to create significant amounts of power, reaching up to ^#CEF400;360W^reset; across their four fuel slots. Uniquely, this generator creates Tritium Rods as a by-product of its fission, with a 50% chance for one to be made each time a fuel item is consumed. It will also create Toxic Waste, two if Tritium is created and one otherwise. While active, depending on how long it's been operating and how much power it's generating, the Fission Generator will begin to flood its nearby area with Moderate Radiation, up to 16 tiles away. Walls and other containment will not block this, only distance and Moderate Radiation immunity will help.

Accepted fuels (power per fuel slot, average decay time):
----------

^#B7E3E5;Small Fusion Reactors^reset;

Harness the power of the stars for your lab, albeit on a very small scale. Fusion Reactors of both kinds fuse light isotopes together, releasing nuclear energy from them to create power. Like the Fission Reactor, Fusion Reactors generate Moderate Radiation the longer and more productively they operate, which cannot be blocked. Small Fusion Reactors have four fuel slots, and can generate ^#B7E3E5;360W^reset; when filling all of them. They must be given coolant to continue operating or will quickly overheat and shut down, releasing a burst of radiation, though water is typically sufficient. Each consumed fuel will create one Toxic Waste, which can be used as coolant in a pinch.

Center: Inventory Transference Network (ITN) devices allow you to create an automated, object-based network that can move and sort any item between your inventory, containers, and the open world. ITN objects use Starbound's wiring system to function, a familiarity with wiring is recommended but not required to use the ITN. All ITN objects are found at the Electronics Center (or its upgraded version, the Power Center).

在庫転送ネットワーク(ITN)デバイスを使用すると、在庫、コンテナ、オープンワールド間で任意のアイテムを移動およびソートできる自動化されたオブジェクトベースのネットワークを作成できます。 ITNオブジェクトはStarboundの配線システムを使用して機能しますが、配線に精通していることをお勧めしますが、ITNを使用する必要はありません。 すべてのITNオブジェクトは、電子工作台(またはアップグレードされたバージョン、Power Center)にあります。

ITN objects use Starbound's wiring system to function, a familiarity with wiring is recommended but not required to use the ITN. All ITN objects are found at the Electronics Center (or its upgraded version, the Power Center).

Pay close attention to the item tooltips for the various ITN objects, these will tell you exactly what each of that object's nodes are used for. Also be aware that some item descriptions will change after being placed - examine them both in your inventory and while placed! Also note that while many of these objects have power nodes that can be used to toggle them between active and inactive, none of the ITN objects require power (as created by generators) to function.

さまざまなITNオブジェクトのアイテムツールチップに注意を払い、これらのオブジェクトの各ノードが何に使われているかを正確に教えてくれます。 また、いくつかのアイテムの説明は配置後に変更されることに注意してください - あなたのインベントリと配置中にそれらを調べてください! また、これらのオブジェクトの多くは、アクティブと非アクティブの間でそれらを切り替えるために使用できるパワーノードを持っているが、機能するために(ジェネレータによって作成されたように)パワーを必要とするITNオブジェクトはない。
Inverted: You can place items in the empty item boxes in the top-right corner of an ITD's configuration screen to tell it to pull specific kinds of items and ignore others. You can further specify whether you want the ITD to pull that exact item, or else the same types or categories of that item. Furthermore, you can specify how many to move at a time by placing stacks of the desired quantity. Using the Inverted Logic setting tells the ITD to ignore that specific, type, or category of item.

ITDのコンフィギュレーション画面の右上隅にある空のアイテムボックスにアイテムを配置して、特定の種類のアイテムをプルして、他のアイテムを無視するように指示することができます。 さらに、ITDがその正確なアイテムをプルするかどうか、あるいはそのアイテムの同じタイプまたはカテゴリを指定することもできます。 さらに、希望する量のスタックを配置することで、一度に移動する数を指定することができます。 Inverted Logic設定を使用すると、アイテムの特定のタイプやカテゴリを無視するようにITDに指示します。

A common, useful storage setup is to have rows of containers and storage bridges all linked to a single terminal (or series of terminals) so you can pull from all of them, with a chest nearby and its storage bridge linked to multiple ITDs that will automatically sort any items you dump into it into specific containers in the network without you having to do anything else.
便利な基本構成は、収納容器とストレージブリッジを列状に並べ、それらを一台の端末（または複数の端末）につないで、どの容器からも取り出せるようにするものだ。さらに近くにチェストを置き、そのストレージブリッジを複数のITDにつなぐ。こうすれば、そのチェストに放り込んだアイテムは、何もしなくてもネットワーク内の指定された容器へ自動で仕分けされる。

Dos:
Dos & Don'ts:

  Do daisy-chain multiple containers. Use ITDs to draw items out of a container dumped to by another ITD to help automatically compress item stacks where possible and to give you more item-specific storage space.

  Do not try to move large amounts of items into a container which already has many items in it. Do not daisy-chain ITDs. These are sources of lag, and ITD configurations do not stack without a separating container.

Dos & Don't:

  複数のコンテナをデイジーチェーン化して、ITDを使って別のITDによってダンプされたコンテナからアイテムを引き出し、可能な限りアイテムスタックを自動的に圧縮し、アイテム固有のストレージスペースを提供します。

  大量のアイテムを、すでに多くのアイテムがあるコンテナに移動しようとしないでください。デイジーチェーンのITDはしないでください。これらは遅延の源であり、ITD構成はコンテナを分離せずにスタックしません。

Dos & Don'ts:

  Do create branching ITD trees along a string of containers where you feel you need to.

  Do Not create any sort of infinite back-and-forth loop that shifts the same items between the same containers unless you have a very good reason to do so. This can be a substantial source of lag.

Dos & Don't:

  必要なコンテナの文字列に沿って、ITDツリーを分岐させるようにしてください。

  よほどの理由がない限り、同じアイテムを同じ容器の間で延々と往復させる、無限ループを作らないでください。大きな処理遅延の原因になります。

Betty:
Retreating to my scout ship wasn't going to be a quiet thing for sure, the sound of their weapon tests ringing out, rocking the air, and shaking my very being. Leaving their jungle huts safely out of my sight, it was only upon reaching the clearing where I had parked my shuttle that it now became clear that my choice of parking spot was a dire mistake. My personal shuttle, dented and firmly smashed up by runaway cannonballs,
several of her systems damaged, the orbital engines nearly critically so. As I flee this planet of the damned, projectile warnings ring out from my Bitching Betty unit. But my shuttle is too damaged for anything but the laziest of evasions, I pray aloud that my ship won't be struck; the ablative plating already having been crumpled into a very expensive ball.

偵察船に退却することは決して静かではなく、彼らの兵器テストの音が鳴り響き、空気を揺さぶり、そして私の存在を揺さぶる。 ジャングル小屋を無事に視界から出ていったのは、私が駐車スペースを空けていたクリアリングにたどり着いた時で、駐車スペースの選択がひどい間違いであることが明らかになったからです。 暴走した砲弾でくぼんでしっかりと破滅させました
彼女のシステムのいくつかは損傷した軌道エンジンはほとんど危機的だった 私はこの惑星から逃げるときに、私のBitching Bettyユニットから発砲警告が鳴ります。 だが、シャトルは損傷がひどく、のろのろとした回避しかできない。船に命中しないでくれと、声に出して祈る。犠牲装甲は、既にひしゃげた、とてつもなく高価な塊になっていた。

Hylotl: So, you know how we pivoted so easily to protecting the Hylotl when the Florans started their war? Well, while we did honestly help defend them, they could've easily kept their numbers as high as they are anyways; we were preventing them from exploding in numbers before the Florans came in and started doing so; we're just preventing the plants from being too aggressive in the population control. Think about it for a bit, and it'll make sense. What do fish and frogs do naturally? Lay a lot of eggs. Hylotl are quite similar in that regard. I'm not sure how there's so many Florans or how more are made, But as for the Hylotl? Eggs out the wazoo.

では、フローランが戦争を開始したとき、ヒュロトルの防衛にどう簡単に動いたかご存知でしょうか? 確かに我々は彼らを守る手助けをしたが、それがなくても彼らは現在の個体数を容易に保てただろう。フローランが現れて同じ役割を担うまでは、我々が彼らの爆発的な増加を抑えていたのだ。今やっているのは、あの植物たちの個体数調整が行き過ぎないようにすることだけだ。 少し考えてみると、それは理にかなっている。 魚やカエルは自然に何をしますか? たくさんの卵を産む。 Hylotlはそれに関して非常に似ています。 フローランがどれだけあるのか、それともどのくらい製造されているのかは分かりませんが、Hylotlはどうでしょう? ワズーを卵で出します。

Several piles of shaved wood sat in one corner, and a huge statue of my Uncle riding an angry Bullfrog made from split logs, decorated the other.

^#EDB347;Jan 9^#FFFFFF; - Kevin was caught stealing large amounts of concentrated sulfuric acid, nitric acid and toluene. After an inspection of his room, a large box of nails was found, with the words 'Death to Equestria' scribbled on the side with crayons.

^#EDB347;Jan 15^#FFFFFF; - Kevin has declared this week 'Vuvuzela Appreciation Week' in honor of a now nearly extinct Earth...instrument...if you can call it that. Within about 11 seconds, we wanted to murder him. We are now on hour seven. I have purchased a new rifle from the Ansible network.

^#EDB347;Jan 24^#FFFFFF; - We received a shipment of about 400 000 of these vuvuzelas from the Ansible network. We also received a 15% discount card off our next big-scale purchase. Kevin was later found fuelling a bonfire with them and grilling mice over it.

^#EDB347;Jan 30^#FFFFFF; - Kevin made a shrine for a bigger more primitive apex-like animal the humans had on earth, called 'haramber' or something. He kept making off with several of the stocked bananas. This only means we need to change the password on the food storage...again.

^#EDB347;Jan 3^#FFFFFF; ――研究設備や消耗品がなくなったという報告を、ほとんどCOで受けています2 キャニスター ストレージのセキュリティを強化することにしました。

^#EDB347;Jan 5^#FFFFFF; 下層での爆発により、ケビンがCOのように見えるものからスチールブレードで木製丸太を発射しているのを見つけた。2 冷蔵庫のスペアパーツとダクトテープから作られた大砲。 後に私は彼が私の叔父スティーブの写真で飾られた私の個人的な貯蔵室に祭壇を構築していたことを発見しました。 彼がどうやってその写真を手に入れたのか私にはわからない。 角にいくつかの削った木の山が座り、片方の丸太からできた怒ったブルカエルに乗って私の叔父の巨大な像がもう一方を飾っていました。

^#EDB347;Jan9^#FFFFFF;-ケビンは大量の硫酸、硝酸、トルエンを盗んだ。 彼の部屋の検査の後、クレヨンで横に「死のエクエストリア」という文字が書かれた大きな箱が発見された。

^#EDB347;Jan15^#FFFFFF; - ケビンは今週、ほぼ絶滅寸前の地球を記念して「Vuvuzela Appreciation Week」を宣言しました。 約11秒以内に、我々は彼を殺害したいと思った。 私たちは今七時です。 私はAnsibleネットワークから新しいライフルを購入しました。

^#EDB347;Jan 24^#FFFFFF; - We received a shipment of about 400 000 アンシブルネットワークからのブブゼラを 次の大型購入で15%割引カードも受け取りました。 ケビンは後に彼らと火を燃やし、その上にネズミを焼くのが見つかった。

^#EDB347;Jan 30^#FFFFFF; ケビンは、人間が地球上に持つより原始的な頂点のような大きな動物を「ハバナー」などという神殿にした。 彼はいくつかの在庫のあるバナナで仲直りを続けた。 これは、食品貯蔵のパスワードを変更する必要があることを意味するだけです。

Darude: Feb 8 - After Kevin somehow got his hands on an ancient audiotrack of the old Earth music known as 'Darude; sandstorm', we weren't bothered at first. When he wouldn't let that damn song get a rest for several hours, even at night, we had to do something. We scheduled a trip to the most nearby desert biome with dangerous sandstorms tomorrow. Lets see if Kevin ever plays that Gods-forsaken song again after being sandblasted for an hour or two. We'll say it's a picnic.

二月8 - ケビンは「Darude; sandstorm」として知られている古い地球の音楽の古代オーディオトラックを何とか手に取った後、私たちは最初は気にしませんでした。 彼がその曲を数時間休ませなかったら、夜でも何かしなければならなかった。 私たちは明日、最も近い砂漠のバイオームに危険な砂嵐で旅行を予定しました。 ケビンが一時間か二時間サンドブラストされた後に、神に捨てられた歌を再生するかどうかを見てみましょう。 ピクニックだと言えるでしょう。

^#EDB347;Feb 10^#FFFFFF; - I found a deep-fried mooshi scrotum on my desk today along with a side of ice cream and a Happy Birthday card. My birthday was nine months ago. He is also aware that I have an allergic reaction to Mooshi.

^#EDB347;Feb 15^#FFFFFF; - We had to make clear to Kevin that 'surprise-feeding' us Glitch food, doesn't make us do 'the robot' any faster but instead gives us horrible indigestion and potentially lethal food poisoning. He insists that our version of science is akin to (and I quote) 'making love to a dead sea lion in the air while on fire'. I am now attempting to picture exactly what this act would look like.

^#EDB347;Feb 18^#FFFFFF; - Norbert finally snapped. He pushed Kevin off the roof after luring him upstairs for 'ninja practice', a thing which no Kevin can resist. We had assumed at long last that we had freed ourselves from his tyrannical pranking. We were sorely mistaken. It turns out he has gene-linked his mind to this facility. Any attempt at murder results in a clone being immediately spawned using his most recent brainscan. He claims 'the station made him do it'. He also apparently 'invented the question mark'.

^#EDB347;Feb 21^#FFFFFF; - Kevin kept persistently saying that 'the bird is the word' today. This made the meeting of the engineering staff awkward, seeing as he just burst in. And Axiena, the fuel-expert of us, who is an Avian was there. Now, being a 'bird' wouldn't be so bad to ignore kevin's 'quirks' but she's also a mute. Being reminded that she couldn't 'be the word' at all (having no vocal capability since birth) was rather rude. Preparing a cake congratulating her on her muteness was worse.

^#EDB347;Feb 24^#FFFFFF; - Kevin came back from a research expedition. He brought somebody named 'Greg' with him. Please kill me.

^#EDB347;Feb 25^#FFFFFF; - Kevin has been missing for several days. Nobody knows where he is. Also, somebody has been eating my cheesecake. I'll ask the cooks to bring it to my office.

^#EDB347;Feb 27^#FFFFFF; - I'm sure somebody is breaking into my personal office to do nothing else but eat my cheesecake. Sounds like something Kevin would do, but he's nowhere to be seen.

^#EDB347;Feb 10^#FFFFFF; ――今日、机の上に揚げたムーシの陰嚢が、アイスクリームとハッピーバースデーカードと一緒にありました。 私の誕生日は九ヶ月前でした。 彼は私がムーシにアレルギー反応を起こしていることも知っている。

^#EDB347;Feb15^#FFFFFF;-私たちはケビンに、私たちを「驚きの餌をやる」ことは、ロボットを速くさせるのではなく、恐ろしい消化不良と潜在的に致命的な食品中毒を与えるということを明らかにしなければならなかった。 彼は、我々の科学は「炎上中に死んだ海ライオンに恋をする」のと似ていると主張する。 私は今、この行為がどのようなものになるかを正確に想像しようとしています。

^#EDB347;Feb18^#FFFFFF; - ついにノーバートがスナップした。 彼はケビンを屋上から追い出して「忍者の練習」と誘った。 私たちはとうとう、彼の暴徒的悪ふざけから解放されたと仮定していた。 私たちはひどく間違いました。 彼はこの施設に遺伝子を結びつけていることが判明した。 殺人の試みは、クローンが直ぐに最新の脳スキャンを使って生成される結果となる。 彼は「駅がそれをした」と主張している。 彼はまた、どうやら「疑問符を発明した」。

^#EDB347;Feb21^#FFFFFF; - ケビンは今日「鳥は言葉だ」と言っています。 これによってエンジニアスタッフの会議は、突如現れたばかりでぎこちないものとなった。 そしてアビエナというアビエナの燃料専門家がいました 今では「鳥」であることは、ケビンの「くしゃみ」を無視しても悪くはないが、彼女はミュートでもある。 彼女が「言葉」になれないことを思い起こされる(生まれてから声の能力がない)というのは、かなり失礼なことだった。 彼女の情けを祝福するケーキを準備するのはさらに悪かった。

^#EDB347;Feb24^#FFFFFF;-ケビンは研究から戻ってきた。 彼はグレッグという名前の人を連れてきた。 私を殺してください。

^#EDB347;Feb25^#FFFFFF;-ケビンは数日の間行方不明です。 彼の居場所は誰も知らない。 また、誰かが私のチーズケーキを食べています。 料理人にそれを私のオフィスに持って来てもらうように頼む。

^#EDB347;Feb 15^#FFFFFF; - We had to make clear to Kevin that 'surprise-feeding' us Glitch food, doesn't make us do 'the robot' any faster but instead gives us horrible indigestion and potentially lethal food poisoning. ^#EDB347;Feb 21^#FFFFFF; - Kevin kept persistently saying that 'the bird is the word' today. This made the meeting of the engineering staff awkward, seeing as he just burst in. ^#EDB347;Feb 24^#FFFFFF; - Kevin came back from a research expedition. He brought somebody named 'Greg' with him. Please kill me.

^#EDB347;Feb 25^#FFFFFF; - Kevin has been missing for several days. Nobody knows where he is. Also, somebody has been eating my cheesecake. I'll ask the cooks to bring it to my office.

^#EDB347;Feb 27^#FFFFFF; - I'm sure somebody is breaking into my personal office to do nothing else but eat my cheesecake. Sounds like something Kevin would do, but he's nowhere to be seen.

^#EDB347;Feb8^#FFFFFF; - ケビンが「Darude; sandstorm」として知られる古い地球の音楽の古代オーディオトラックを手にしてから、私たちは最初は気にしませんでした。 彼がその曲を数時間休ませなかったら、夜でも何かしなければならなかった。 私たちは明日、最も近い砂漠のバイオームに危険な砂嵐で旅行を予定しました。 ケビンが一時間か二時間サンドブラストされた後に、神に捨てられた歌を再生するかどうかを見てみましょう。 ピクニックだと言えるでしょう。

^#EDB347;Feb15^#FFFFFF;-私たちはケビンに、私たちを「驚きの餌をやる」ことは、ロボットを速くさせるのではなく、恐ろしい消化不良と潜在的に致命的な食品中毒を与えるということを明らかにしなければならなかった。 彼は、我々の科学は「炎上中に死んだ海ライオンに恋をする」のと似ていると主張する。 私は今、この行為がどのようなものになるかを正確に想像しようとしています。

^#EDB347;Feb18^#FFFFFF; - ついにノーバートがスナップした。 彼はケビンを屋上から追い出して「忍者の練習」と誘った。 私たちはとうとう、彼の暴徒的悪ふざけから解放されたと仮定していた。 私たちはひどく間違いました。 彼はこの施設に遺伝子を結びつけていることが判明した。 殺人の試みは、クローンが直ぐに最新の脳スキャンを使って生成される結果となる。 彼は「駅がそれをした」と主張している。 彼はまた、どうやら「疑問符を発明した」。

^#EDB347;Feb21^#FFFFFF; - ケビンは今日「鳥は言葉だ」と言っています。 これによってエンジニアスタッフの会議は、突如現れたばかりでぎこちないものとなった。 そしてアビエナというアビエナの燃料専門家がいました 今では「鳥」であることは、ケビンの「くしゃみ」を無視しても悪くはないが、彼女はミュートでもある。 彼女が「言葉」になれないことを思い起こされる(生まれてから声の能力がない)というのは、かなり失礼なことだった。 彼女の情けを祝福するケーキを準備するのはさらに悪かった。

^#EDB347;Sep12^#FFFFFF;-ケビンは今日、リロドンをかき混ぜて科学者を追いかけ、強度を増す音を鳴らしていた。 もっと大きな船をもらうようにとよく示唆する。 関連するニュースでは、私たちのボートはすべて行方不明です。

^#EDB347;Sep12^#FFFFFF;-ケビンは今日、リロドンをかき混ぜて科学者を追いかけ、強度を増す音を鳴らしていた。 もっと大きな船をもらうようにとよく示唆する。 関連するニュースでは、私たちのボートはすべて行方不明です。

^#EDB347; Sep 13^#FFFFFF; - 大きなブザー音が私たちを狂わせています。 ケビンの部屋から来ています 私は彼がまたその蜂をやっていると良い。

^#EDB347;Sep14^#FFFFFF; - 蜂の音が止まり、今日はかなり大量の牛乳が配達されました。 正確には 2972 カートンです。 理由がわからない。

^#EDB347; Sep19^#FFFFFF; - ミルクのカートンは「Sour Milk and Bees」にリラベルされています。 全ての個人店の食材はこれと入れ替わっています。 一方、私たちの食べ物は、ドレスに精巧に縫い付けられています。

^#EDB347;Sep8^#FFFFFF; - ケビンはタイムトラベルを考え出した。 君たちを殺せ!

^#EDB347; Sep9^#FFFFFF; - 今日、スタッフにいくつかのリブ破砕損傷が報告されました。 さらなる調査で、私はVinalisjが彼の背中にテープテープで印があることを発見しました。 「FREE RIDES $0.25」と表示されます。 皆が一日だけケビンのいたずらに付き合うことにしたらしい。その結果、所長の尻尾に飛び乗っては、すぐさま近くの壁や机へ投げ飛ばされる者が何人も出たようだ。

^#EDB347;Sep10^#FFFFFF; - 取締役のオフィスドアは、頭蓋骨が取り付けられた石の暗号ドアのように粗く塗られ、彼の名前のプレートは「これはビナルボスです」と書かれたポスターに置き換えられました。 唯一の方法は、スティーブのストレージロッカーを開いて、約4tonの重さのキーを得ることです。 キーに触れると、非常に大きな声がボスキーを取得し、キャッチーな4-note音を鳴らします。 ストレージからキーを削除しない限り、移動しようとする試みは不可能です。 誰もそうするほど強い人はいない。
Appreciation:
^#EDB347;Jan 3^#FFFFFF; - I've been getting reports of missing lab equipment and consumables, mostly CO2 canisters. I've decided to increase storage security.

^#EDB347;Jan 5^#FFFFFF; - An explosion on the lower levels led to us finding Kevin launching wooden logs at a steel blade from what appears to be a CO2 cannon, constructed from fridge spare parts and duct tape. Later I also found out he was building an altar in my personal storage room decorated with photographs of my Uncle Steve. I have no idea how he got the pictures. Several piles of shaved wood sat in one corner, and a huge statue of my Uncle riding an angry Bullfrog made from split logs, decorated the other.

^#EDB347;Jan 9^#FFFFFF; - Kevin was caught stealing large amounts of concentrated sulfuric acid, nitric acid and toluene. After an inspection of his room, a large box of nails was found, with the words 'Death to Equestria' scribbled on the side with crayons.

^#EDB347;Jan 15^#FFFFFF; - Kevin has declared this week 'Vuvuzela Appreciation Week' in honor of a now nearly extinct Earth...instrument...if you can call it that. Within about 11 seconds, we wanted to murder him. We are now on hour seven. I have purchased a new rifle from the Ansible network.

^#EDB347;Jan 24^#FFFFFF; - We received a shipment of about 400 000 of these vuvuzelas from the Ansible network. We also received a 15% discount card off our next big-scale purchase. Kevin was later found fuelling a bonfire with them and grilling mice over it.

^#EDB347;Jan 30^#FFFFFF; - Kevin made a shrine for a bigger more primitive apex-like animal the humans had on earth, called 'haramber' or something. He kept making off with several of the stocked bananas. This only means we need to change the password on the food storage...again.

^#EDB347;Jan 3^#FFFFFF; ――研究設備や消耗品がなくなったという報告を、ほとんどCOで受けています2 キャニスター ストレージのセキュリティを強化することにしました。

^#EDB347;Jan 5^#FFFFFF; 下層での爆発により、ケビンがCOのように見えるものからスチールブレードで木製丸太を発射しているのを見つけた。2 冷蔵庫のスペアパーツとダクトテープから作られた大砲。 後に私は彼が私の叔父スティーブの写真で飾られた私の個人的な貯蔵室に祭壇を構築していたことを発見しました。 彼がどうやってその写真を手に入れたのか私にはわからない。 角にいくつかの削った木の山が座り、片方の丸太からできた怒ったブルカエルに乗って私の叔父の巨大な像がもう一方を飾っていました。

^#EDB347;Jan9^#FFFFFF;-ケビンは大量の硫酸、硝酸、トルエンを盗んだ。 彼の部屋の検査の後、クレヨンで横に「死のエクエストリア」という文字が書かれた大きな箱が発見された。

^#EDB347;Jan15^#FFFFFF; - ケビンは今週、ほぼ絶滅寸前の地球を記念して「Vuvuzela Appreciation Week」を宣言しました。 約11秒以内に、我々は彼を殺害したいと思った。 私たちは今七時です。 私はAnsibleネットワークから新しいライフルを購入しました。

^#EDB347;Jan 24^#FFFFFF; - We received a shipment of about 400 000 アンシブルネットワークからのブブゼラを 次の大型購入で15%割引カードも受け取りました。 ケビンは後に彼らと火を燃やし、その上にネズミを焼くのが見つかった。

^#EDB347;Jan 30^#FFFFFF; ケビンは、人間が地球上に持つより原始的な頂点のような大きな動物を「ハバナー」などという神殿にした。 彼はいくつかの在庫のあるバナナで仲直りを続けた。 これは、食品貯蔵のパスワードを変更する必要があることを意味するだけです。

Smarties:
^#EDB347;Feb 2^#FFFFFF; - Someone switched all of the Smarties with Skittles.

^#EDB347;Feb 8^#FFFFFF; - After Kevin somehow got his hands on an ancient audiotrack of the old Earth music known as 'Darude; sandstorm', we weren't bothered at first. When he wouldn't let that damn song get a rest for several hours, even at night, we had to do something. We scheduled a trip to the most nearby desert biome with dangerous sandstorms tomorrow. Lets see if Kevin ever plays that Gods-forsaken song again after being sandblasted for an hour or two. We'll say it's a picnic.

^#EDB347;Feb 9^#FFFFFF; - Yep. He kept playing the song. Louder. He then composed a version completely in reverse, played only with vomit sounds and a strange repeated word: 'Yolo'.

^#EDB347;Feb 10^#FFFFFF; - I found a deep-fried mooshi scrotum on my desk today along with a side of ice cream and a Happy Birthday card. My birthday was nine months ago. He is also aware that I have an allergic reaction to Mooshi.

^#EDB347;Feb 15^#FFFFFF; - We had to make clear to Kevin that 'surprise-feeding' us Glitch food, doesn't make us do 'the robot' any faster but instead gives us horrible indigestion and potentially lethal food poisoning. He insists that our version of science is akin to (and I quote) 'making love to a dead sea lion in the air while on fire'. I am now attempting to picture exactly what this act would look like.

^#EDB347;Feb 18^#FFFFFF; - Norbert finally snapped. He pushed Kevin off the roof after luring him upstairs for 'ninja practice', a thing which no Kevin can resist. We had assumed at long last that we had freed ourselves from his tyrannical pranking. We were sorely mistaken. It turns out he has gene-linked his mind to this facility. Any attempt at murder results in a clone being immediately spawned using his most recent brainscan. He claims 'the station made him do it'. He also apparently 'invented the question mark'.

^#EDB347;Feb 21^#FFFFFF; - Kevin kept persistently saying that 'the bird is the word' today. This made the meeting of the engineering staff awkward, seeing as he just burst in. And Axiena, the fuel-expert of us, who is an Avian was there. Now, being a 'bird' wouldn't be so bad to ignore kevin's 'quirks' but she's also a mute. Being reminded that she couldn't 'be the word' at all (having no vocal capability since birth) was rather rude. Preparing a cake congratulating her on her muteness was worse.

^#EDB347;Feb 24^#FFFFFF; - Kevin came back from a research expedition. He brought somebody named 'Greg' with him. Please kill me.

^#EDB347;Feb 25^#FFFFFF; - Kevin has been missing for several days. Nobody knows where he is. Also, somebody has been eating my cheesecake. I'll ask the cooks to bring it to my office.

^#EDB347;Feb 27^#FFFFFF; - I'm sure somebody is breaking into my personal office to do nothing else but eat my cheesecake. Sounds like something Kevin would do, but he's nowhere to be seen.

^#EDB347;Feb 2^#FFFFFF; - 誰かがスリトルですべてのSmartiesを切り替えました。

^#EDB347;Feb8^#FFFFFF; - ケビンが「Darude; sandstorm」として知られる古い地球の音楽の古代オーディオトラックを手にしてから、私たちは最初は気にしませんでした。 彼がその曲を数時間休ませなかったら、夜でも何かしなければならなかった。 私たちは明日、最も近い砂漠のバイオームに危険な砂嵐で旅行を予定しました。 ケビンが一時間か二時間サンドブラストされた後に、神に捨てられた歌を再生するかどうかを見てみましょう。 ピクニックだと言えるでしょう。

^#EDB347;Feb 9^#FFFFFF; -はい。 彼はその歌を演奏し続けた。 ルーダー。 その後、彼は完全に逆でバージョンを作曲し、吐声と奇妙な繰り返し単語「Yolo」でのみ演奏しました。

^#EDB347;Feb 10^#FFFFFF; ――今日、机の上に揚げたムーシの陰嚢が、アイスクリームとハッピーバースデーカードと一緒にありました。 私の誕生日は九ヶ月前でした。 彼は私がムーシにアレルギー反応を起こしていることも知っている。

^#EDB347;Feb15^#FFFFFF;-私たちはケビンに、私たちを「驚きの餌をやる」ことは、ロボットを速くさせるのではなく、恐ろしい消化不良と潜在的に致命的な食品中毒を与えるということを明らかにしなければならなかった。 彼は、我々の科学は「炎上中に死んだ海ライオンに恋をする」のと似ていると主張する。 私は今、この行為がどのようなものになるかを正確に想像しようとしています。

^#EDB347;Feb18^#FFFFFF; - ついにノーバートがスナップした。 彼はケビンを屋上から追い出して「忍者の練習」と誘った。 私たちはとうとう、彼の暴徒的悪ふざけから解放されたと仮定していた。 私たちはひどく間違いました。 彼はこの施設に遺伝子を結びつけていることが判明した。 殺人の試みは、クローンが直ぐに最新の脳スキャンを使って生成される結果となる。 彼は「駅がそれをした」と主張している。 彼はまた、どうやら「疑問符を発明した」。

^#EDB347;Feb21^#FFFFFF; - ケビンは今日「鳥は言葉だ」と言っています。 これによってエンジニアスタッフの会議は、突如現れたばかりでぎこちないものとなった。 そしてアビエナというアビエナの燃料専門家がいました 今では「鳥」であることは、ケビンの「くしゃみ」を無視しても悪くはないが、彼女はミュートでもある。 彼女が「言葉」になれないことを思い起こされる(生まれてから声の能力がない)というのは、かなり失礼なことだった。 彼女の情けを祝福するケーキを準備するのはさらに悪かった。

^#EDB347;Feb24^#FFFFFF;-ケビンは研究から戻ってきた。 彼はグレッグという名前の人を連れてきた。 私を殺してください。

^#EDB347;Feb25^#FFFFFF;-ケビンは数日の間行方不明です。 彼の居場所は誰も知らない。 また、誰かが私のチーズケーキを食べています。 料理人にそれを私のオフィスに持って来てもらうように頼む。

^#EDB347;Feb 27^#FFFFFF; 誰かにチーズケーキを食べてもらうため、私室に押し入られるのではないでしょうか。 ケビンがやることみたいだけど、彼は見られない。
Nilson:
^#EDB347;Mar 1^#FFFFFF; - After routine inspection everything has been accounted for, except the prototype phase shift module Dr. Nilson has been working on. I have a very bad feeling about this.

^#EDB347;Mar 2^#FFFFFF; - I found a note on my desk. 'You talk about cheesecake while you sleep. You also snore. Love, Kevin.'. I think I need to undergo psychiatric reevaluation.

^#EDB347;Mar 4^#FFFFFF; - Kevin refused to work with any of the Glitch this week. Kept yelling that he couldn't bare the thought of thinking with those 'console peasants'. Which was odd, as the Glitch in that group aren't even near any console-panels.

^#EDB347;Mar 8^#FFFFFF; - Kevin assaulted several crewmembers by throwing a capture capsule in their face after yelling at the top of his lungs - and I quote - 'Our eyes have met, we must battle!'. We still have no idea when, or how he managed to catch an adult Fleshreaper.

^#EDB347;Mar 12^#FFFFFF; - He won't stop saying 'Eureka! I've done it!' and is running around like a maniac.

^#EDB347;Mar 20^#FFFFFF; - He is still doing the Eureka thing.

^#EDB347;Mar 28^#FFFFFF; - Well, he's finally showed us what his Eureka moment is. Apparently, he has single-handedly discovered how to make hamsters able to self-replicate instantly via application of sunlight. Why he thinks this is a pleasing result, that's another story entirely. He set them loose from his rather cramped lab into the goddamned *greenhouse*!

^#EDB347;Mar 29^#FFFFFF; - He shared the reason of why he made this hamster fiasco happen; It was purely so that he could make a star system completely composed of hamsters. A ham-star, he said.

^#EDB347;Mar 1^#FFFFFF; - ルーチン検査の後、Nilson博士が取り組んでいるプロトタイプフェーズシフトモジュールを除いて、すべてが説明されています。 私はこれについて非常に悪い感情があります。

^#EDB347;Mar 2^#FFFFFF; - 机の上にメモを見つけました。 寝ている間にチーズケーキの話をするのね。 あなたもいびきをかきます。 愛してるよ、ケビン。'. 私は精神医学の再評価を受ける必要があると思います。

^#EDB347;Mar 4^#FFFFFF; - ケビンは今週、グリッチのいずれかで作業することを拒否した。 と叫んでも、あの「コンソール農民」の考えを否定できなかった。 そのグループのグリッチは、コンソールパネルの近くにさえないので、それは奇妙でした。

^#EDB347;Mar 8^#FFFFFF; - ケビンは、肺の上部で叫んだ後、彼らの顔に捕獲カプセルを投げて、いくつかの乗組員を攻撃しました - そして、私は引用 - '私たちの目は会った、我々は戦わなければなりません! いつ、どのようにして成体のヒラメを捕まえたのか、まだわからない。

It is considered their divine right to rule, and their word sways the entire races' social/economic development for the next ten years. In more recent times, this has been abused, and the current head of the temple council - Ka'tir Upitah - intends to keep her rule until she eventually dies, claiming to be a direct messenger from the deity Ahvis.

'The star-children of the First wanted to drive away the anti-children. We aided the anti-children. Their nebulas were safe, and through them came the Birthing'.

However, we can find no record of this conflict in any known galactic database. If it happened it was a long, long time ago.
